prompts.prompt: Production artwork for Zoe Force, painted 2D side-scrolling / vertically-scrolling shooter. Use the attached approved Bio-Cathedral concept strictly as STYLE reference: intricate Giger-inspired biomechanical bone, obsidian metal, sinew, tubes, believable painted texture and Contra Shattered Soldier density, Life Force organic architecture. Generate a CLEAN BACKGROUND asset only: NO ship, enemies, bosses, bullets, projectiles, UI, text, logos or frame. Landscape 16:9. Architectural detail lies mainly near perimeter and in distant layers; the middle 65% is dim misty low-contrast negative space so live entities and bright fire remain readable. Seam-friendly matching dark edges; no foreground obstructions crossing the center. Production art, not a screenshot or concept board. VOLCANIC ASCENT: view down an immense vertical black basalt shaft with biomechanical armored flanks on screen-left and screen-right (decreasing/increasing X). Molten red-orange lava in fissures at the edges, black cooling towers, volcanic vents, steel fortress embedded in the rock, fine ash haze. Warm amber edge lights, middle dark charcoal and smoke. No painted ceiling or floor blocking upward flight.
